1. SUBSCRIPTION SCOPE & PRICING
Provider grants Customer access to Adobe Creative Cloud Enterprise and Document Cloud services.
Total Annual Contract Value: $24,000.00 USD (payable annually in advance).
Allocated Seats: 50 Named User Licenses.
Current Active Utilization: 21 of 50 assigned seats (41% active utilization rate observed during the last quarterly audit).

2. TERM AND AUTOMATIC RENEWAL
2.1 Term: This Agreement is effective for an initial period of twelve (12) months, terminating on October 18, 2026 ("Expiration Date").
2.2 Automatic Renewal: UNLESS EITHER PARTY PROVIDES WRITTEN NOTICE OF NON-RENEWAL AT LEAST THIRTY (30) DAYS PRIOR TO THE EXPIRATION DATE (ON OR BEFORE SEPTEMBER 18, 2026), THIS AGREEMENT SHALL AUTOMATICALLY RENEW FOR A SUCCESSIVE TWELVE (12) MONTH TERM AT PROVIDER'S THEN-CURRENT STANDARD LIST PRICE.

3. TERMINATION & CANCELLATION NOTICE
3.1 Written notice of termination or intent not to renew must be formally submitted to renewals@adobe.com or through the Adobe Admin Console.
3.2 Failure to submit timely written notice by September 18, 2026 will irrevocably commit Customer to the subsequent annual payment of $24,000.00 USD.

4. GOVERNING LAW & COMPLIANCE
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Ireland, subject to mandatory local consumer and commercial statutory protections.
